title: CodeChallenge: Large and small MAUVE explorations

cues.en: Now that you know how the mauve evaluation works and how to implement it in Python, I'd like to do
cues.zh: 既然知道 MAUVE 如何評估，以及 Python 實作，接著做

cues.en: some more explorations so you can get more familiar with this approach, and also see the kinds of diversities in scores that you can get.
cues.zh: 更多探索，熟悉這種方法，也看看分數能有多少變化。

cues.en: Just a warning this code challenge takes a long time, not necessarily because it's so difficult that
cues.zh: 先提醒，這個挑戰很耗時，不一定因為難寫，

cues.en: it takes you a long time to code, but generating the tokens that you need to run this analysis can take 20 to 25 minutes per exercise.
cues.zh: 而是生成分析所需詞元，每個練習可能就要 20 到 25 分鐘。

cues.en: So there will be time for you to code, and there will be time for you just to let the analysis run while you go off and do something else.
cues.zh: 所以有時間寫程式，也有時間讓分析自己跑，去做其他事。

cues.en: The goal of exercise one is to import the small and large versions of GPT two.
cues.zh: 練習一，匯入 GPT-2 small 與 large。

cues.en: Follow the code from the previous exercise to generate 100 repetitions of 400 tokens for each model.
cues.zh: 依照上一個練習程式，讓每個模型生成 100 次、每次 400 詞元。

cues.en: So that is slightly bigger than what we were doing in the previous video.
cues.zh: 比上一支稍大。

cues.en: Now, depending on the processor that you have access to, this might take somewhere around 25 minutes just to run.
cues.zh: 依能使用的處理器，光執行也許就約 25 分鐘。

cues.en: So when you're setting up your code, test it on small chunks of data, for example, three repetitions of ten tokens each.
cues.zh: 設定程式時，先用小資料測試，例如三次、每次十詞元。

cues.en: And by the way, there are ways to decrease this calculation time that I will discuss in the code.
cues.zh: 另外，有方法減少運算時間，程式裡會談。

cues.en: One more point about this exercise that is slightly different from the code we ran in the previous video.
cues.zh: 這次與上一支還有一點不同。

cues.en: Remember that in the previous video we were not actually inputting tokens into the mauve function.
cues.zh: 上一支不是把詞元輸入 MAUVE，

cues.en: Instead, we were inputting the text into the mauve function and internally it was tokenizing them.
cues.zh: 而是輸入文字，再由內部斷詞。

cues.en: What I would like you to do here in this exercise, and actually in this entire code challenge, is input tokens and not text.
cues.zh: 這個練習，甚至整個挑戰，希望輸入詞元，而不是文字。

cues.en: So you do not actually need to generate text here.
cues.zh: 因此，不必真的產生文字，

cues.en: You need to generate tokens and you can leave them as tokens.
cues.zh: 只需生成詞元，保留詞元形式。

cues.en: So now you can pause the video and work through this exercise.
cues.zh: 現在可以暫停，完成練習。

cues.zh: 不希望結果是 100

cues.en: The goal of exercise two is to implement the mauve analysis using six different human written texts as references.
cues.zh: 練習二，用六份不同人類文本當參照，實作 MAUVE。

cues.en: Now thinking back to the formula for KL divergence.
cues.zh: 回想 KL 公式，

cues.en: The idea is that we hold the probability distribution p fixed and we vary the q distribution.
cues.zh: 也就是固定分布 P，改變 Q。

cues.en: You can use these books that we have been using several times before in this course.
cues.zh: 可以用這門課已用過幾次的書。

cues.zh: 為了匹配模型樣本數與詞元數，每本都要抽一百批，

cues.en: of 400 tokens each from each of these books.
cues.zh: 每批 400 詞元。

cues.en: So that means that the model text and the human text will have exactly the same number of list items, each of which has exactly the same number of tokens.
cues.zh: 所以模型、人類的串列項目數完全相同，每項詞元數也完全相同。

cues.en: So that helps to ensure that we have a fair comparison in the analysis.
cues.zh: 有助公平比較。

cues.en: So that produces two models and six texts, which gives us 12 results in total.

cues.zh: x 軸每本書，都有 GPT-2 small 與 large 的 MAUVE 分數。

cues.en: Now, obviously you're going to get some diversity in these results.
cues.zh: 顯然，結果會有變化。

cues.en: And I would like you to think about, first of all, what that diversity means and where it comes from.
